# WebCrawlers

> WebCrawlers is building one platform that connects the APIs behind its supported
> tools for search and AI visibility. Customers' agents will access those capabilities
> through one authenticated MCP interface. People will use the same audit service
> through the website. Direct implementation with Adam is a separate option.
> The unified customer platform is in development, not publicly available.
> We guarantee delivery of agreed tools, connections or implementation, not
> appearance in any AI chat or a particular search ranking.
> The currently available assisted website service has the following scope.
> The starting scope is one website, one language, up to 30 agreed pages,
> up to three technical fixes and one existing-page clarity change.
> Rankings, AI mentions, traffic and sales are not guaranteed.

Contact: hello@webcrawlers.tech

The initial enquiry and scope conversation are free. A detailed audit or repairs
need an accepted written quote. The quote identifies any combined or separate
audit and repair charges, amount, currency, tax treatment, payment milestones,
delivery dates and revision allowance. No fixed public price is published.
Adam replies within two business days. Delivery timing is agreed separately.
The agreed-fix follow-up is 30 days after the approved release.

The planned free self-service check, public customer sign-in and subscriptions
are not currently available through the public website. Content, a new website
and work outside the starting scope need their own agreement.
